description: This is a React component for Tag Management in a UI, handling creation, deletion, viewing, and editing of tags. It interacts with backend APIs for tag data and model info, managing state for modals, tag list, and selected tags.

methods.name: fetchTags
methods.description: Fetches the list of tags from the backend using tagListCall API, updates the local state.

methods.name: handleRefreshClick
methods.description: Triggers fetchTags to refresh the tag list and updates the last refreshed timestamp.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new tag, calls API, shows notifications, and refreshes tag list.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Prepares to delete a tag by setting state with the tag name.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms deletion of the selected tag via API call, then refreshes list and shows notifications.
